review_provenance: Requirements, backend, Terraform and evaluation-harness critiques were performed by role-separated agents where available; their external vetoes remain active. Focused repairs pass their local reviewer gates, but no final exact-tree evaluator, distinct GitHub reviewer or real cloud-plan reviewer result is claimed.

findings.description: The baseline UI and Python runtime had no shared authoritative control plane.
findings.evidence: The default UI now consumes persisted FastAPI responses and live Playwright reaches the PostgreSQL-backed control plane.

findings.description: Baseline run and approval state was process-local and not tenant, hash, policy or command bound.
findings.evidence: SQL persistence, canonical manifest checks, migration 0003, audit linkage, replay/concurrency and restart tests cover the boundary.

findings.target: browser to API to PostgreSQL transport
findings.description: The audited prior tree had only mocked frontend fetch tests and an API smoke that bypassed the UI.
findings.required_fix: Independently rerun both Playwright scenarios against the live Compose stack and inspect that no transport interception exists.
findings.evidence: Producer ran two approval/rejection Playwright cases twice with persisted reload/refresh and no route interception.

findings.description: Approval rows did not directly carry the idempotency key and audit linkage relied on inference.
findings.required_fix: Verify migration 0003 backfill/fail-closed behavior and direct response/audit linkage.
findings.evidence: Approval contract, row and audit payload now carry the key; migration tests cover safe legacy linkage and orphan failure.

findings.description: Wrong-policy and nonexistent-run approval behavior lacked direct tests.
findings.required_fix: Independently rerun explicit wrong-policy and nonexistent-run tests.
findings.evidence: Focused tests now assert validation failure for greenlight.v0 and not-found for a missing run.

findings.description: Tenant and principal identity existed only as request headers and database rows without direct versioned response schemas.
findings.required_fix: Verify the strict identity endpoint and frontend OpenAPI drift mapping.
findings.evidence: GET /api/v1/identity returns strict v1 tenant/principal schemas and denies missing development identity.

findings.description: Provider timeout, duplicate delivery/event replay and failed migration cases were not explicit enough in the audited prior evidence.
findings.required_fix: Independently inspect rollback/event counts and migration fail-closed assertions.
findings.evidence: Timeout rollback, duplicate run delivery without duplicate events, migration orphan failure and startup migration failure coverage now exists.

findings.description: Earlier foreign keys did not force dependent rows to share the parent tenant.
findings.evidence: Migration 0002 adds composite tenant ownership constraints and current PostgreSQL integration denies cross-tenant read and approval.

findings.description: The smoke printed artifact/evidence counts but did not fail when either count differed from eight.
findings.required_fix: Rerun unit and live smoke checks with exact count assertions.
findings.evidence: verify_run now rejects any result not containing exactly eight artifacts and eight evidence records.

findings.description: The documented uv sync --frozen environment lacked PyYAML although validate_platform invokes YAML parsing.
findings.required_fix: Run the documented frozen setup and platform command in current CI.
findings.evidence: PyYAML is now a locked development dependency and validate_platform chooses the reproducible backend interpreter when available.

findings.description: Main now requires the exact four CI jobs and protected review controls, but the repaired tree has no exact GitHub Actions result and the updated workflow is not yet on main.
findings.required_fix: Commit and push the repair, obtain a green exact-tree run, keep the draft PR unmerged, and obtain an eligible non-self PR review before any later merge.

findings.description: The prior eval-results artifact did not satisfy the mandatory per-requirement schema or executable harness requirement.
findings.required_fix: Finish the root-owned catalog/result generation, validate exact traceability coverage and rerun it on the final tree.

findings.description: Protected dev-build/dev-plan/dev environments now exist and dev prevents self-review, but its configured reviewer is also the only collaborator, so no distinct actor/reviewer pair can satisfy the gate.
findings.required_fix: Add a distinct eligible reviewer/actor without weakening prevent-self-review, then read back the environment approval and protected attestation boundary.

findings.description: Repair producers have not yet passed both focused critics and a new independent final evaluator.
findings.required_fix: Complete TASK-BACKEND-CRITIC-003 and TASK-TERRAFORM-CRITIC-004 then deploy EVAL-INC-004 against the committed exact tree.

findings.description: An exact-name candidate project now exists but its creator, purpose and authorization for bootstrap or dev are unknown.
findings.required_fix: Obtain an explicit create/adopt decision bound to reviewed evidence and choose a distinct second project; do not infer adoption from the name.
findings.evidence: Candidate ai-native-content-agency-saas is ACTIVE but billing-disabled, unlabeled and outside Terraform state.

findings.description: All six visible billing accounts are closed and no authorized parent or region exists.
findings.required_fix: Make an intended open billing account visible and explicitly authorize parent, distinct project roles and region before preflight.

findings.description: No saved target plan, plan JSON, source hash, image digest or exact attestation exists.
findings.required_fix: After eligibility and permission gates, produce the saved plans and inspect exact create/update/replace/destroy actions.

findings.description: A broad role name does not prove the required project, billing, API, IAM, WIF, state and resource permissions.
findings.required_fix: Run the granular target-specific preflight and record missing permissions without tokens.

findings.description: All three deployment environments exist with protected-branch rules and dev prevents self-review, but no Actions variables are configured, no distinct reviewer exists, and the repaired deploy workflow is not on main.
findings.required_fix: After current CI and a later authorized merge, add a distinct reviewer, populate the twelve variables only from reviewed foundation outputs, protect the exact attestation secret in dev, and read everything back.

findings.description: No selected target region or real plan exists for an exact or defensible estimated monthly cost.
findings.required_fix: Price the inspected target plan and record assumptions before ALLOW_DEV_APPLY.

findings.description: The prior WIF condition bound mutable owner and repository names but not immutable numeric IDs.
findings.required_fix: Independently verify OIDC mappings and negative Terraform tests for both immutable IDs.
findings.evidence: Current mappings and conditions check repository_owner_id and repository_id alongside names/ref/workflow/environment.

findings.description: The prior create_project=false path referenced but did not manage or import an existing project.
findings.required_fix: Independently verify negative adoption tests and later bind the real decision to evidence before any target plan.
findings.evidence: CREATE_NEW or ADOPT_EXISTING is mandatory; adoption uses a versioned acknowledgement and Terraform import.

findings.description: The prior runtime root did not compare its region with the foundation output.
findings.required_fix: Rerun positive and negative foundation binding tests.
findings.evidence: Foundation exports region and runtime preconditions require an exact match.

findings.description: The prior roots did not enforce that bootstrap and dev project IDs differ.
findings.required_fix: Rerun the negative same-project test and inspect runtime foundation checks.
findings.evidence: Dev and runtime gates require project_id to differ from bootstrap_project_id.

findings.description: The prior role allowed Cloud Run service/job deletion and retained project-wide service IAM mutation.
findings.required_fix: Keep the exact 16-permission set synchronized and independently inspect any future role change.
findings.evidence: Delete and run.services.setIamPolicy are absent; foundation owns project-level roles/run.servicesInvoker rather than job-capable roles/run.invoker; runtime owns no service IAM member; 22 Terraform tests, seven post-apply tests and 58 static controls pass.

findings.description: The earlier design treated a pre-existing verified email channel as a manually created dependency instead of a Terraform-owned resource.
findings.required_fix: Independently verify the two-phase create/import gate and later prove human verification and delivery against the exact managed channel.
findings.evidence: Terraform now owns gcp-notification-channel.v1 CREATE_NEW or ADOPT_EXISTING resources, sensitive email input, import/provenance, prevent_destroy and an enabled/VERIFIED evidence gate before costly resources; runtime binds its provenance digest.

findings.description: An independently repeated same-tenant same-key same-payload approval race returned one durable 200 and one APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED 409 because the losing transaction did not re-read the idempotency record committed after its initial replay check.
findings.required_fix: After rollback of only the approval-already-decided race, re-read and return the exact durable idempotency response when tenant, key, operation and canonical hash match; add a deterministic concurrent regression and preserve incompatible conflicts.
findings.evidence: A fresh evaluator repeated the repaired identical approval race 12 times; every iteration returned two equal 200 bodies and exactly one approval, idempotency record and approval audit.

findings.target: concurrent same-key run start provider ownership
findings.description: Concurrent identical run.start calls persist and return one run but both execute all seven sandbox tools first, producing 14 tool logs and one rolled-back run identity.
findings.required_fix: Before any effectful adapter is enabled, add a cross-instance durable key ownership/lease or database advisory lock acquired before provider execution; meanwhile record the sandbox-only limitation and keep external_side_effects false.
findings.evidence: A fresh evaluator repeated the repaired identical start race 12 times; each returned equal 201 bodies with one run/command/audit and exactly seven tool evidence/log records for the one run ID.

findings.description: The post-apply verifier checked exact plan/deploy project roles but did not inspect project roles granted to the runtime service account, so a drifted broad role could pass.
findings.required_fix: Require exactly roles/cloudsql.client, roles/cloudsql.instanceUser, roles/logging.logWriter and roles/monitoring.metricWriter for the runtime member and reject every extra role.
findings.evidence: The post-apply verifier now requires the runtime member's exact four-role set; missing-role and extra-role negatives pass in the 65-test platform suite.

findings.description: Runtime checked digest syntax but did not require the application image to use the foundation Artifact Registry prefix or constrain the proxy to an explicitly trusted registry.
findings.required_fix: Bind the application image to the foundation repository and constrain the proxy registry, with wrong-registry negative tests.
findings.evidence: Runtime planning binds repository/app@sha256 to the foundation output and the proxy to one source-reviewed release/digest; post-apply verifies exact named service/job containers and wrong-source/name tests fail closed.

findings.description: Cleanup can delete versions older than seven days unless among the 20 newest while the runbook did not bound rollback to a digest that still exists.
findings.required_fix: Protect an explicit rollback retention convention or require executable digest-existence proof before producing a rollback plan and document the bounded window.
findings.evidence: Plan and protected apply jobs prove the desired/current digest, bind the candidate, and move one rollback-current KEEP tag only after exact attestation and permission preflight using a two-permission tag role; ordering and negative tests pass.

findings.description: Post-apply evidence did not verify live WIF claims, state-bucket authority, phase impersonation bindings, repository roles or the deployed custom-role permission set.
findings.required_fix: Add fail-closed foundation post-apply evidence for every identity and state authority boundary.
findings.evidence: Post-apply now compares all three WIF providers and impersonation policies, plan/apply state bindings, complete repository IAM, exact runtime and rollback custom roles, and immutable repository claims; drift negatives pass.

findings.description: No open billing account, authorized parent/region/targets, saved plan, cost evidence, deployment variables or distinct reviewer path exists.
findings.required_fix: Authorize eligible cloud targets and an independent reviewer, then produce and critique exact saved plans without mutating the unrelated active project.

findings.description: The result checker accepted a fabricated 52-item all-PASS/INFO report because it did not bind top-level source/catalog/aggregate fields or canonical per-requirement fields to the catalog.
findings.required_fix: Validate exact report metadata, current source tree provenance, recomputed aggregates/hard gates and every catalog-bound evaluation field, with tamper-negative tests.
findings.evidence: Nineteen evaluator/governance tests now reject forged all-PASS, catalog field, aggregate, gate, source and commit-provenance tampering; stale checked-in results correctly exit 2.

findings.description: The local harness did not execute scripts/postgres_integration.py, so same-key concurrency and cross-tenant PostgreSQL evidence existed only in CI outside the catalog.
findings.required_fix: Add a hermetic fresh PostgreSQL catalog gate and map APP-002 APP-004 APP-008 SEC-001 and the complete-suite requirement to it.
findings.evidence: A root rerun built the isolated locked test stage, migrated fresh PostgreSQL through 0003, returned two equal 201 responses with one durable run and seven tool records, denied cross-tenant access, recreated the application, and removed the exact volume.

findings.description: The first catalog runner executed TestClient inside the deployed runtime image, whose intentionally minimal dependency lock omits httpx2, so the real gate failed before its API probes.
findings.required_fix: Use a separate locked ephemeral integration-test image/stage with CI test dependencies while leaving the production runtime image unchanged, then rerun the fresh gate.
findings.evidence: The Dockerfile now has a non-deployed postgres-integration stage with the existing hash-locked CI requirements; the production runtime still omits httpx2 and the fresh real gate passes as UID 10001.

findings.target: task ownership and ordered phase governance
findings.description: Governance validation accepted blank task roles/objectives/owners, nonsense statuses, dependency cycles and therefore could falsely certify producer-to-evaluator ordering.
findings.required_fix: Require typed non-empty task contracts, declared dependencies, an acyclic graph, ordered critical path/mandatory phases and no overlapping active write locks.
findings.evidence: Governance 14/14 passes on 34 typed tasks, an acyclic graph, 19 ordered critical edges, mandatory phase chain and non-overlapping active locks; blank/cycle/order/conflict negatives pass.

findings.description: The local Compose E2E preserves its volume and the PostgreSQL script used fixed keys, allowing a later run to pass through old durable replay without exercising contention.
findings.required_fix: Use an isolated fresh per-run database/project or unique namespace while retaining a separate explicit restart-persistence scenario.
findings.evidence: Fresh executions used generated owned projects and UUID command namespaces; PostgreSQL contention passed, three browser scenarios passed including restart persistence, and both exact volumes were removed.

findings.description: The transaction advisory lock has no explicit lock or statement timeout, so a same-key waiter can block indefinitely if the holder or inline provider stalls.
findings.required_fix: Set a bounded transaction-local PostgreSQL lock timeout before advisory acquisition, roll back on timeout and return the existing safe structured 503 without weakening ownership.
findings.evidence: The evaluator verified READ COMMITTED then transaction-local 5000ms lock_timeout then advisory acquisition; six focused cases proved rollback and redacted 503 behavior.

findings.description: The first fresh three-scenario run restored the durable row after restart but failed because docker compose start app also traversed the completed one-shot migration dependency and returned nonzero.
findings.required_fix: Restart only the already-created application service, retain readiness and exact-row assertions, and rerun the complete fresh stack.
findings.evidence: The test now uses app-only docker compose restart; lint/typecheck pass and a fresh owned stack completed all three browser scenarios in five seconds before exact volume cleanup.

findings.target: strict harness Python lint and format parity
findings.description: The first source-commit harness run exposed that root-level Ruff checks did not apply backend/pyproject.toml to scripts, so the stricter backend-cwd gates found three B905 violations and 20 unformatted scripts.
findings.required_fix: Declare the intended strictness for unequal zip iterables, format backend and scripts with the canonical backend configuration, and rerun the exact lint, format, governance and platform gates before regenerating results.
findings.evidence: All three loops now declare strict=False; the canonical Ruff lint and 58-file format check pass, 19 evaluator/governance tests pass, and the complete source-only platform gate passes 24 Terraform tests, 65 script tests and 61 static controls.

findings.description: The required in-app browser exposed no browser instances, so manual desktop/narrow viewport and accessibility QA is unproven.
findings.required_fix: Repeat interactive inspection when an in-app browser instance is available; do not substitute Playwright behavioral evidence for manual visual evidence.
